Privacy Tools

Everything is processed locally in your browser. Your keys, passphrases, signatures, and messages are never sent over the network.

Tools for non-specialists:

AES Encryption AES Decryption Secret Sharing (Shamir) Secret Reconstruction GPG / OpenPGP Tools Standalone QR Code Generator

Technical tools:

Public-key Encryption Public-key Decryption Message Signature Signature Verification

These tools use the following libraries:

  • secrets-ts
  • QR-Code-generator
  • OpenPGP.js

Source: https://github.com/click-and-shield/privacy-forge
